artifact_inventory.method: Inert ELF/Bun table parsing with bounds assertions and content hashes; no target execution during extraction.
artifact_inventory.limitation: Inventory completeness does not imply semantic coverage of every execution path.

review.finding: All 42 policy roles located by source/AST comparison and public exports, then checked against their callers and behavior. Similarity search only nominates candidates; ambiguous minified bindings were resolved manually.
All nine exporters and metric SDK retain their implementation shape after excluding minified names and module paths; actual original/protected exporter tests pass.

Classifier verdict/category and cache-creation duration token fields still enter the logger route; GenAI provider/conversation fields still require the tracing gates. Existing initialization, logger-provider, tracing and exporter controls apply. Callers may still construct local attributes before a disabled sink.

Current-directory lookup has revised session-context error handling. Beta-state create/clone now preserve a refusedToolSchemas map. Bindings point to the actual factories and cwd wrapper. Project detection, request handling and non-streaming recovery pass.

Poll response and tools_host validation, timeout and logging behavior changed; forwardDiagnostics retains its endpoint and payload contract. Only the diagnostics member is replaced, preserving shared business methods.

Datadog event naming now uses a host-scoped conversion helper. The disabled emitter/factory boundary is unchanged. Reviewed first-party initializer and error initialization gate retain their behavior apart from build metadata and minification.
Public trackFrameEvent re-export resolves to the reviewed event producer; shared API client, asynchronous return contract and preview/surface selection remain covered by positive and negative tests.
18 known reporting endpoint literals in each corpus. The only textual difference is a minified variable in a loopback metrics URL; no new literal endpoint in this scoped comparison.
review.limitation: Does not prove absence of new dynamically constructed URLs, renamed transports or unrecognized reporters.

fixture_change.description: Read the system-message queue observer binding from the reviewed version profile. Require the same core module; retain module hash and binding checks. The older 2.1.296 audit fallback still requires the exact original artifact hash.

preserved: business requests and shared functional APIs
limitations: Synthetic local receivers, isolated configs and fake credentials; no real account login or paid model calls.
Remote Control, font rendering and long sessions were not validated in this update.
Known optional reporting controls are not proof of zero data transmission or server-side privacy.
No assertion about account risk scoring or server-side acceptance of every request.
